slide_mappings.title: TITLE SLIDE
slide_mappings.reason: Matches the official SIH title requirements: high-contrast hero typography, problem statement metadata ledger, team credentials, and live prototype proof badge.
transferred_techniques: Official SIH 2026 header emblem logo
Color-coded statutory metadata panel (PS ID, Category, Ministry)
Team P84 badge with registered team name Innovexa
Live working prototype badge with 5,000+ works telemetry

slide_mappings.title: PROPOSED SOLUTION
slide_mappings.reason: Adheres strictly to the four evaluation pointers (Overview, Explanation, Problem Addressed, Innovation) in a balanced 2x2 quadrant layout.
transferred_techniques: Numbered circular step badges (1 to 4)
Color-coded 4px top accent strips (Navy, Orange, Green, Blue)
Bullet point hierarchy emphasizing the 8 models, Risk Fusion v2.0, and sub-200ms latency
Official SIH header and footer frame

slide_mappings.title: TECHNICAL APPROACH
slide_mappings.reason: Structures the technical narrative into Technologies Used (4-card top ribbon) and the end-to-end Methodology Pipeline Flowchart.
transferred_techniques: 4-Column categorized tech stack cards
Sequential pipeline container showing ingestion -> 7 domain models + XGBoost -> Risk Fusion formula -> SHAP output
Directional arrows and mathematical formula callout box
Official SIH header and footer frame

slide_mappings.title: FEASIBILITY AND VIABILITY
slide_mappings.reason: Splits the canvas into a 3-pillar Feasibility Analysis (Technical, Operational, Economic) and a direct Challenge-Mitigation matrix.
transferred_techniques: Left column: 3 Feasibility cards with colored left border indicators
Right column: High-visibility Red alert header for Challenges paired with Green header for Mitigations
District median baseline normalization and human override callouts
Official SIH header and footer frame

slide_mappings.title: IMPACT AND BENEFITS
slide_mappings.reason: Combines a 4-tier Stakeholder Impact ribbon (DM, MoSPI, State, MP) with a comprehensive 4-row Quantifiable Benefits table.
transferred_techniques: Top 4-card stakeholder distribution ribbon
Structured tabular grid with official navy header row and alternating clean rows
Hard empirical evidence callouts: Rs 1.84 Cr Satna pilot, 18-month audit compression to <200ms
Official SIH header and footer frame

slide_mappings.title: RESEARCH AND REFERENCES
slide_mappings.reason: Directly addresses the SIH research criteria across Statutory Guidelines, Algorithmic Citations, and Open-Source Repository.
transferred_techniques: Two-column split: Left Statutory Guidelines (MoSPI Rule 14.2, CVC, GFR 155)
Right column: Peer-reviewed literature (Tree SHAP, Graph AI, Benford) + Verified GitHub Repository card
